s: Al kos sheni en mebarekin ubo g' seipim: yesh nohagin shello lebarek "bore peri haggapen" al kos sheni, lepi shenniptar be"bore peri haggapen" shebberak al kos rishon. Veken lo yebarek al kos rebii, lepi shenniptar bemah shebberak al kos shelishi. Veap al pi shehipsiq harbeh benetayim baamirat hahaggada vehallel, kevan sheen kan hessach haddaat mishshetiyya, shehare keshebberak al kos rishon haya yodea sheyyishteh od kos sheni. Veken keshebberak al kos shelishi haya yodea sheyyishteh od kos rebii. Vegam bishat amirat hahaggada lo hissiach dato mishshetiyya, shehare im haya rotzeh haya yakol lishtot beemtza hahaggada meiqqar haddin. Veap ben shelishi lirbii sheasur lishtot, mikkol maqom kevan shehakkos omed lepanayv vedato lishtot mimmennu kesheyyesayyem hahaggada — hare lo hissiach dato mishshetiyya, ulepikak en tzarik lachazor ulebarek al hashshetiyya. Umah shetztzarik lebarek al kos shelishi shel birkat hammazon ap al pi [she]keshebberak al kos rishon haya bedato lishtot od g' kosot, hattaam hu: lepi shebbirkat hammazon hu gemar vesilluq al hasseuda sheakal — hare zo chashuba kehepseq vehessach haddaat mishshetiyya, kevan shebbishat birkat hammazon i epshar lo lishtot, shei epshar lishtot uledabber keechad. Abal amirat hahaggada vehahallel ap al pi sheggam ken i epshar lo lishtot uledabber keechad, ap al pi ken enah chashuba hepseq vehessach haddaat mishshetiyya, sheamira zo enah gemar vesilluq al mah sheqqodem laken (ayyen siman qa"ch):

Ubimdinot ellu nohagin lebarek gam al kos sheni urebii, lepi shed' kosot ellu tiqqenu chakamim lishtotam derek cherut, vekol echad veechad hu cherut umitzva bipne atzmah, ulepikak enan mitztorpin zeh im zeh lehippater bibraka achat, ella tzarik lebarek al kol echad veechad bipne atzmo:

Vekol zeh leinyan beraka rishona, abal beraka haacharona al hayyayin — en lebarek achar shum kos, ki im achar kos haacharon. Vaapillu lehaomerim shehahallel vehahaggada chashubim hepseq leinyan beraka rishona, mikkol maqom leinyan beraka acharona enan chashubim hepseq, vekol hakkosot niptarin bibraka acharona sheyyebarek achar kos haacharon. Vaapillu birkat hammazon shehu gemar vesilluq al hasseuda vechashub kehepseq vehessach haddaat leinyan beraka rishona, mikkol maqom leinyan beraka acharona en hessach haddaat mazqiq lebarek beraka acharona miyyad achar haakila o hashshetiyya shehissiach dato mimmenna, ella yakol lehamtin ad sheyyehe nimlak lachazor veleekol o lishtot, vibarek achar otah haakila o shetiyya veyiptor gam et zo, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"t:
